mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (amphetamine prodrug) may lower lamotrigine seizure threshold through CNS stimulation while lamotrigine metabolism may be affected by amphetamine-induced changes in hepatic function and urinary pH.
action: Monitor seizure control and lamotrigine levels; counsel patient on seizure risk; consider alternative ADHD medication if seizure disorder is present or lamotrigine levels become subtherapeutic.
